# CANDIDATE: MIN_GAP_REENTRY_FILTER

**Filed:** 2026-08-24  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** filter_change  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Adding a minimum time gap between same-quality re-entries will reduce consecutive losses from premature re-trades after a stop-out, improving edge_capture by avoiding low-quality re-entries that compound losses. This addresses the pattern observed in L07 where same-quality re-entry without min-gap caused back-to-back losses.

## Mechanism

After a trade exits due to stop-loss (any stop type), enforce a minimum gap (e.g., 45 minutes) before allowing another entry of the same setup quality tier (TRENDLINE, LEVEL, ELITE, SUPER) on the same day. If the gap is not met, block the re-entry. This is implemented in the quality-escalation lock logic in `risk_gate.py` by checking `setup_last_exit_time_today[lock_key]` and requiring `(current_time - last_exit_ts).total_seconds() >= MIN_GAP_SECONDS` before permitting a same-quality re-entry.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+; $1K paper ~= 14% headline (per OP-20 disclosure #1).  
2. **Sample bias:** Stage-1 backtest will use the full 16-month SPY 5m dataset (2025-01-02..2026-06-18) with no look-ahead bias; sample size is all bars; overfit risk mitigated by walk-forward and OOS validation.  
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (will run walk-forward OOS after Stage-1).  
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (will validate on top 3 J days using realistic OPRA simulator).  
5. **Failure modes:** worst day could be if the gap filters out a valid re-entry that would have recovered losses; max drawdown scenario if gap causes missed winners during strong trends; blow-up scenario if gap causes excessive whipsaw losses due to forced inactivity.  
6. **Concentration:** unknown -- requires Stage-1 backtest to compute top-5 days % of P&L.

## Pre-merge gate

<what tests need to pass: gym validators, walk-forward, real-fills>

- Gym validators: all unit tests in `backtest/tests/` must PASS.  
- Walk-forward: OOS Sharpe ratio >= 0.70 and per-month rate consistency >= 0.70 of IS.  
- Real-fills: top 3 J days P&L diff vs BS sim < ±20% (per L12).  
- Anchor no-regression: edge_capture on J winner days must not decrease (delta >= 0).  
- OP-20 disclosures must be filled with actual results post-backtest.

## Confidence

5 / 10 -- based on logical premise from L07 but lacking empirical validation; could be neutral or negative if gap filters out profitable re-entries.
